svg.title: Speculative RAG worked example
svg.desc: Query Q with four docs goes to clustering (A has d1 and d2 about Morgan, B has d3 and d4 about Robert). Two subsets are sampled, each feeds a drafter that outputs rationale beta and answer alpha. The verifier scores each draft, argmax picks the Morgan draft as final answer.

g.text: low: β does not support α
